description: This file defines a UserController class with methods for creating, reading, updating, and testing user data, utilizing Express.js request/response handling and external user service.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Controller class handling user-related HTTP requests such as create, read, update, and test.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles user creation requests, calls UserService.createUser, and returns the created user.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Handles user retrieval by ID or email, manages database query runner, and sanitizes user data before response.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles user update requests, verifies current user, and updates user data via UserService.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Simple test endpoint returning a 'Hello World' message.
